title: Fluffy Kenyana Pancakes with Nutty Sauce
description: Delicious pancakes made with Kenyana flour and topped with a nutty sauce made from the finest ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine Kenyana flour, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until combined.
Add the mashed bananas and nutty mixture and stir until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and grease with pate.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with a drizzle of nutty sauce.
To make the nutty sauce, combine nutty and fluffy in a blender and blend until smooth.
Add a little water to achieve the desired consistency.
Serve the pancakes with a side of fresh fruit or maple syrup.
